name: Brothers Coffee Roastery - Great Brak River
address: 8 Rheeboksfontein, Great Brak River, 6525, South Africa
description_short: Artisan coffee roastery and café serving freshly roasted beans and wholesome café fare in Groot Brak River.
description_long:
Brothers Coffee Roastery brings the art of coffee roasting to Groot Brak River, where the aroma of freshly roasted beans welcomes you into this friendly neighbourhood café. Watch the roasting process while enjoying expertly crafted espresso drinks made from beans roasted on site, alongside a menu of wholesome breakfast and lunch options that complement their coffee perfectly.

The café doubles as a store where you can purchase their freshly roasted coffee beans to take home, making it a favourite stop for both locals and travellers passing through the Garden Route. The relaxed atmosphere and genuine passion for quality coffee create a welcoming space whether you're grabbing a quick takeaway or settling in for a leisurely breakfast. Their commitment to the craft shows in every cup, and the friendly service keeps people coming back.
